send_message_to_user: send a message from the agent to the user and optionally wait for a user response
send_message_to_agent: send a message from the user to the agent with optional file attachments
get_last_unread_messages: retrieve all unread messages from the user and agent conversation history
get_all_messages: retrieve all messages from the conversation sorted by most recent timestamp first
send_user_message_to_agent: send a user response to the agent with optional CLI input timeout support
